sections.name: summary
sections.label: In short
sections.content: Meaning stops at the repository boundary; the return of federation, starting with cross-repository addressing, is ratified.

sections.name: body
sections.label: The evidence
sections.content: Decision 31e9fd27 (ratified 2026-10-16) orders the return: RFC-049 addressing, then cross-repository relations, then multi-repository MCP. It answers SP-86 (a record cannot link to a record in another repository) and SP-87 (an agent works in one repository at a time), under cluster c583f5d7 and strategy contract 586cd1ec. SP-09 (knowledge arrives without its meaning attached) names relations among what is lost.

sections.name: open
sections.label: Open
sections.content: Is any cross-repository graph needed before RFC-049 (Draft) is accepted?
